long_biography.plain_text:
Kazchrome gave Alijan Ibragimov a direct operating role inside the metals businesses that became Eurasian Resources Group. As chairman, he consolidated the Aksu and Aktobe ferroalloy plants with the Donskoy mining operation, strengthening production from ore extraction through processing. Under his leadership, the company expanded its chrome reserves and ferroalloy position while introducing integrated management systems.

Ibragimov had trained in industrial economics at the Moscow Veterinary Academy before moving into business. He later chaired Aluminium of Kazakhstan and remained an ERG founder-shareholder and board member. Beyond industrial investment, he promoted specialist training, employee facilities and scholarships for Kazakh students studying abroad.
